caveat: Post-selection descriptions on already inspected data. Agreement with C03 is not independent correctness or predictive utility.

method.method: One-at-a-time only; continuous thresholds +/-5%, integer breadth counts +/-1. Report all material thresholds and note inactive branches; no grid, selection or canonical edit.

interpretation.largest_observed_boundary: k_broad +/-1 changes108/97 of1930 states (5.60%/5.03%); in already-seen F3_TEST41/31 of420 (9.76%/7.38%). This is the priority boundary for prospective adjudication of breadth, not automatic retuning.
interpretation.continuous_thresholds: Each single +/-5% continuous perturbation changes at most48/1930 decisions (2.49%, v_watch lower). Low aggregate disagreement does not prove safety at rare events.
interpretation.zero_effect_does_not_mean_unreachable: curve_flat upper, curve_adverse lower and rho_floor lower have zero historical regime effect for this perturbation. Branch activity, overlapping predicates and limited sample matter; canonical conditions remain intact.
